name: workvillage
description: A pixel-art village above your prompt that grows as your project progresses.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language: auto follows your system locale.

size.title: Size
size.description: small is a 7-row picture; medium is 10 rows with a summary line. Both fill the width of the band.

palette.title: Colours
palette.description: color is full colour and grayscale shades of grey. The mono palettes are black-and-white line art: mono follows your terminal's own colours, mono-light is black on white and mono-dark white on black.

pixel.title: Pixel size
pixel.description: How large each pixel is drawn. small uses half-size pixels in kitty and Ghostty and finer pixels on the desktop; other terminals draw two pixels per character cell at every setting.

link.title: Settings link
link.description: Where the Settings link sits: hint on the hint line under the prompt, top above the village, bottom below it, or hidden (open the settings with /village settings).

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: full animates villagers smoothly, reduced updates once a second, off draws a still picture.
